poses.label: Stand
poses.description: Hold a dumbbell at each side with both feet planted.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Bend your hips and knees together and keep your chest up.

poses.label: Bottom
poses.description: Lower until your thighs are about parallel, with the weights at your sides.

poses.label: Stand up
poses.description: Push through your whole foot to stand.

limitations: The draft illustrates the side-hold variation in the app cue.
Phone playback and admin review are pending.
